description: Golden hour and blue hour — Photography light planner for US locations: golden hour (sun 6 degrees above to 4 below the horizon) and blue hour (4 to 6 below) for morning and evening, sunrise/sunset/solar noon in local time, plus an NWS sky-cover and precipitation rating for each sunrise and sunset (GREAT / GOOD / FAIR / POOR) and the best upcoming session. Params: lat, lon (or place=), days (1-7, default 3). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_golden_hour
